item.title: Review of the Statement of Solicitor Competence and the SQE Functioning Legal Knowledge

proposed_record.title: Updates to the Statement of Solicitor Competence and FLK proposed
proposed_record.summary: The SRA is consulting on updates to the Statement of Solicitor Competence and the SQE functioning legal knowledge. The Statement sets the standards expected of all solicitors throughout their careers.
what_changes: Proposed competence updates cover use of technology and AI, supervision, health and wellbeing, and professional conduct and ethics.
A new separate section would set out the competences needed to supervise others, including their use of technology and AI.
Proposed changes to functioning legal knowledge (FLK) would add clarity and add or remove content.
The consultation ran until 3 December 2026. Final versions are due in April 2027, with changes taking effect from September 2027.
proposed_record.who_it_applies_to: All SRA-regulated solicitors and the firms that employ and supervise them, plus SQE candidates.

history.event: Consultation page confirmed final versions due April 2027 and changes taking effect from September 2027.
